newsitem.title: USA: PP&L Susquehanna 1 nuclear unit in startup.
newsitem.headline: PP&L Susquehanna 1 nuclear unit in startup.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power and Light's 1,090 megawatt (MW) Susquehanna 1 nuclear unit is in startup mode following repairs to the main condenser, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Tuesday.
The unit was manually shut Feb 25 in anticipation of a loss of vacuum in the unit's main condenser, which removes heat from steam leaving the unit's main turbine.
The adjacent unit 2, with a generating capacity of 1,094 MW, is scheduled to shut March 15 for refueling.
Both units are located in Berwick, Pa.
